new_assertions.body: The post-reduction component multiset is not an independent-subgame decomposition: safe-forgetting rules induce remote component changes even though raw q_o component transitions are local.

The effective cross-component coupling needed to reconstruct R/F/G/H can be compressed to a small global scheduler; restoring deleted residual bridge tokens is unnecessary for these reduction semantics.

The exact 5x3 SAT2 collision proves that scalar-value sufficiency can be strictly coarser than transported action-value and future-behavior sufficiency within the same frozen structural component representation.
A context-free component valuation phi(C) is premature before quotienting or parameterizing the scheduler action, because a move in one component can change disjoint reduced components.
The natural current algebraic carrier is a contextual/scheduler-graded commutative component monoid rather than an exponent-2 group.

Failure of component multiplicity parity at the current post-RFG stage does not falsify a later XOR law; the unresolved object is the contextual semantic quotient/valuation of components after scheduler effects are accounted for.
